title: BEWT-CovExt v2.0 Behavioral Taxonomy Baseline & RQ2 Denominator

defensibleDenominator.denominatorDefinition: An orthogonal tuple (Domain Entity, Action / Operational Mode, Observable Invariant / State Transition) invariant to parameter variation or minor syntax rephrasing.

kanboard.title: Reopen a closed task
kanboard.observableContract: Task status changes from closed to open in database and UI badge; task reappears on active Kanban board and matches status:open query.

kanboard.title: Create and view a task comment
kanboard.observableContract: Comment record is inserted into comments table linked to task_id; comment text and author username render in the task comment stream.

kanboard.title: Duplicate a task to another project
kanboard.observableContract: New task record created in project Beta with copied title/description; source task record in project Alpha remains unmodified.

kanboard.title: Move a task to another project
kanboard.observableContract: Task project_id is updated to Project B; task disappears from Project A board and appears in Project B first column.

kanboard.title: Add an internal subtask to a task
kanboard.observableContract: Subtask row inserted into subtasks table with task_id FK; subtask table renders item with default status 'Todo'.

bludit.title: Scheduled pages are promoted on a request after their due time
bludit.observableContract: Database page entry status transitions from scheduled to published; page renders in published public collection.

bludit.title: Cover image selection persists and renders for content
bludit.observableContract: page.coverImage field persists the image identifier and theme template resolves and renders image tag.

bludit.title: Static status maps to page type and the static-page collection
bludit.observableContract: dbPages categorizes record under static collection rather than published posts stream; static navigation resolves page.

bludit.title: Administrator can change a non-admin user's role and retain it
bludit.observableContract: dbUsers record updates role field to administrator; subsequent session grants admin route permissions.

bludit.title: Category creation and filtered content listing
bludit.observableContract: dbCategories registers category slug; public category route filters posts by category key.

claroline.title: Course document upload, move and delete lifecycle
claroline.observableContract: Document records in claro_document table update path during move and delete marks record deleted; filesystem confirms file existence then removal.

claroline.title: Group space is inaccessible to a non-member student in a private group
claroline.observableContract: claro_is_in_a_group check fails; claro_disp_auth_url denies access; HTTP redirect and error message triggered.

claroline.title: Teacher imports an exercise package into a course
claroline.observableContract: exercise and question tables populated from zip package XML schema; imported exercise immediately available for student attempts.

claroline.title: Tracking controls are teacher-only while exercise attempts remain student-facing
claroline.observableContract: Tracking UI restricted by is_course_allowed('tracking'); tracking database logs student score and renders aggregated analytics for teacher.

claroline.title: Course announcement creation, publication, and student notification visibility
claroline.observableContract: claro_announcement table receives new record; course home view pulls and displays active announcements.

expresscart.title: Stock tracking rejects a cart quantity above available product or variant stock
expresscart.observableContract: routes/index.js cart update validates against productStock; rejects over-quantity and leaves session cart count at 1.

expresscart.title: Customer address update persists and is copied from session into checkout information
expresscart.observableContract: POST /customer/update updates database and req.session.customer*; checkout view automatically inherits session address.

expresscart.title: Invalid discount date windows are rejected during admin update
expresscart.observableContract: routes/admin.js discount update validates start_date < end_date; rejects invalid range and preserves prior DB state.

expresscart.title: Customer registration validation rejects duplicate email address with clear feedback
expresscart.observableContract: POST /customer/create queries db.customers.findOne; finds duplicate email and returns HTTP 400 error.

expresscart.title: Admin product stock update directly updates storefront inventory badge and cart capability
expresscart.observableContract: Stock update persists in MongoDB; storefront product view dynamically renders in-stock badge and unlocks cart addition.

joomla.title: Featured article flag appears and is removed from the featured list
joomla.observableContract: content_frontpage table entry is created then deleted; article published state in #__content remains 1.

joomla.title: Publish-up and publish-down define the article visibility window
joomla.observableContract: SQL queries filter by (publish_up <= NOW() AND (publish_down >= NOW() OR publish_down = '0000-00-00 00:00:00')).

joomla.title: Editor without edit-state permission cannot change publication state
joomla.observableContract: com_content checks JAccess::check($userId, 'core.edit.state'); denies unauthorized state change attempt.

joomla.title: Editing an article increments its version counter and creates history record
Article trash and restore lifecycle restores prior published status
joomla.observableContract: #__content.state transitions 1 -> -2 -> 1; public view hides trashed articles and re-displays restored articles.

mantisbt.title: User monitors and stops monitoring an issue for their own account
mantisbt.observableContract: mantis_bug_monitor_table adds then deletes (user_id, bug_id) record; UI updates monitor button toggle and list.

mantisbt.title: Private issue note is hidden from users below the private-note threshold
mantisbt.observableContract: bugnote view query filters by view_state == 50; users below private_bugnote_threshold cannot see private notes.

mantisbt.title: Issue relationship rejects self-link and duplicate links
mantisbt.observableContract: mantis_bug_relationship_table enforces uniqueness and disallows source_bug_id == dest_bug_id.

mantisbt.title: Issue attachment upload is persisted and rejects invalid input
mantisbt.observableContract: mantis_bug_file_table stores file metadata; file content stored in disk/db and retrievable via file_download.php.

mantisbt.title: Issue tag attachment, display, and tag-based issue filter retrieval
mantisbt.observableContract: mantis_tag_table and mantis_bug_tag_table link tag to bug; filter query joins tag table and returns matching issues.

mediawiki.title: Moving a page preserves content at the target and creates a redirect
mediawiki.observableContract: page title is updated in page table; old page title becomes page with redirect flag and body #REDIRECT [[Current Feature Guide]].

mediawiki.title: Watch and unwatch state is scoped to the signed-in user
mediawiki.observableContract: watchlist table receives row (wl_user, wl_namespace, wl_title) for Alice only; Bob's query returns null.

mediawiki.title: Upload validation rejects a disallowed file extension without creating a file page
mediawiki.observableContract: UploadBase::checkFileExtension returns FILE_EXTENSION_ERROR; no record in image table or File: page created.

mediawiki.title: Revision history side-by-side diff comparison between two consecutive edits
mediawiki.observableContract: DifferenceEngine renders table.diff containing class 'diff-deletedline' and class 'diff-addedline' with expected texts.

mediawiki.title: Page protection restriction level modification restricts editing to administrators
mediawiki.observableContract: page_restrictions table receives row (pr_page, pr_type='edit', pr_level='sysop'); userCan checks user_groups; denies non-admin.

prestashop.title: Cart-rule per-customer usage limit is enforced
prestashop.observableContract: CartRule::checkValidity verifies count in ps_order_cart_rule against quantity_per_user; rejects second redemption.

prestashop.title: Carrier eligibility follows configured price/weight range
prestashop.observableContract: Carrier::getCarriersForOrder evaluates ps_range_price; filters available carriers based on order subtotal.

prestashop.title: Successful payment creates one order and applies stock synchronization
prestashop.observableContract: PaymentModule::validateOrder creates ps_orders row, order history entry, and calls StockAvailable::updateQuantity(-2).

prestashop.title: Available quantity update stays consistent with product combination stock
prestashop.observableContract: ps_stock_available stores distinct rows per id_product_attribute; frontend AJAX update correctly reflects combination quantity.

prestashop.title: Customer group discount applies configured percentage reduction to catalog price
prestashop.observableContract: Product::getPriceStatic applies Group::getReduction($id_group); computes effective price $80.00.
